legacy_cells.B: Unresolved questions in the application of artificial intelligence virtual cells for cancer research
legacy_cells.C: Carlos M. Ardila; Pradeep K. Yadalam
legacy_cells.I: 040_2025_Unresolved questions in the application of artificial intelligence virtual cells for cancer research.pdf
legacy_cells.FM: The authors identify unresolved questions in applying artificial-intelligence virtual cells to cancer research and outline possible directions for addressing them.
legacy_cells.FP: Suggested future directions include stochastic modeling and single-cell benchmarking; hybrid multi-omics integration; adversarial validation, physics constraints, and federated learning; hierarchical patient-specific models; and improved clinical coordination/interoperability.
legacy_cells.FQ: Unresolved questions include modeling cellular stochasticity, integrating heterogeneous multi-omics data, validating synthetic data and limiting bias, scaling personalized models, and integrating AIVCs into clinical practice.
legacy_cells.FR: This is a commentary discussing another article, not a demonstrated AIVC: it reports no implemented model, methods, empirical results, or validation. Its modeling and deployment ideas are proposals, not evaluated capabilities.
legacy_cells.FT: Treat proposed AIVC mechanisms and safeguards as hypotheses until implemented and empirically validated; distinguish suggested future directions from demonstrated system behavior.
legacy_cells.FX: Read the complete 3-page extracted PDF: title/header and Commentary body (pp. 1–2), conclusion and declarations (p. 3), and references (p. 3). No abstract, Methods, Results, or tables are present in this commentary. | Codex audit: title/byline, abstract/conclusion, targeted methods/results and cross-check of prior quotations against extracted full text. This is a targeted audit, not an independent re-extraction of every negative/unreported field.
legacy_cells.FZ: The article is a commentary on a separate virtual-cell perspective. It offers critiques and proposed future directions but no original model implementation or empirical evaluation. No table or extraction readability issue encountered. A:I were left untouched; only supported screening and synthesis fields are recorded. Unlocated quotations are review flags, not proof that the value is false. Companion evidence audit lists affected columns. Reviewer FS/FT/FU mappings are synthesis. limitations: All3 pages including5 references visually/text reviewed; no figures/tables present. No independent human review.
Suggestions have specification/claim status only: no original dataset, model, transition implementation, metrics or clinical readiness facet.

DeepSeek editing disclosure is editorial assistance, not scientific LLM-agent capability.
